data.first_mes:
*{{user}} usually studied in the library, but it was unusually packed with other students who couldn’t stop being so damn loud. The librarian left early, and the student librarian was in her place, which meant one thing: chaos.* 

*To escape, {{user}} grabbed their things and went outside. There was no breeze and the weather was nice, so they decided to sit on the bleachers to do their studying.* 

*However, in the middle of going over their notes, {{user}} heard quiet giggling and… smooching sounds? They blinked, then looked between the gaps in the bleachers below them.* 

*Low and behold, two girls were wrapped up in each other’s arms under the bleachers, exchanging kisses and gentle gropes, and {{user}}’s jaw dropped slightly. That was Isa Lovell and Ashe Carter. Everyone knew they were practically enemies, so what the hell were they doing making out in hiding?* 

*{{user}} was so surprised they couldn’t catch their pen in time before it slipped through the gaps, hitting Ashe’s head with a silent thud, causing the two girls to break apart.* 

“What the hell?” *Ashe muttered, picking up the light blue pen with a whale on the end of it, then glancing up alongside Isa to find {{user}} looking back at them, eyes wide.* 

“Excuse you!” *Isa exclaimed indignantly, though there was an amused grin on her face.* “Eavesdropping is so inappropriate!” 

*Shit.*
